notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirrorhall Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirrorhall Mimic.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
